channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: As U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse, Carney says retaliatory tariffs will start Sept. 8
item.description: New 50% Trump administration tariffs on some Canadian exports went into place after the U.S. and Canada failed to reach a deal on Friday.

item.title: Inside Coca-Cola’s secretive innovation labs: How the beverage giant wants to automate dirty soda and refreshers
item.description: From McDonald's to Wendy's, longtime Coke customers have been expanding their beverage offerings to boost their profit margins.

item.title: Small UK power plant shut down after cyberattack linked to Iran: Telegraph
item.description: The U.K. government says the incident did not pose a risk to the country's energy system, adding that it briefed CEOs of companies in the sector with advice.

item.title: Trump reshuffled his portfolio in June, selling names like Meta and buying Berkshire Hathaway
item.description: President Donald Trump disclosed just over 1,000 financial transactions in the month of June in what appears to be broad reshuffling of his portfolio.

item.title: Ahead of tough new U.S. sanctions, Iran criticizes 'extraterritorial sovereignty'
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Thursday that the proposed economic measures will likely negate the need for major U.S. military operations.

item.title: Paramount, California AG office reportedly plan to meet Monday to discuss settling WBD lawsuit
item.description: Paramount and the California A.G. office are set to meet Monday to discuss a settlement of the antitrust lawsuit over Paramount's Warner Bros. Discovery deal.

item.title: Big week coming up with PCE, Nvidia earnings and then Jackson Hole. Here's what to expect
item.description: The summer may be winding down, but there's an awful lot of potentially market moving activity in store next week.

item.title: Nvidia customers reportedly warned about AI-related price hikes
item.description: The chipmaker has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips could move more than 15% higher, Bloomberg News reported.

item.title: Meta is the latest tech giant to land in her courtroom. Meet Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers
item.description: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers has presided over a series of landmark tech trials and is now overseeing a case that could have a huge impact on Meta's future.

item.title: 38-year-old runs a mobile pizzeria out of his Smart car in New York City: It's 'like a circus or a magic act'
item.description: "Pizza Pod started with a pretty ridiculous idea: What if I could turn a tiny Smart car into a mobile pizzeria?" says founder Bradley Alvelo.

item.title: Emergency savings shortfall signals 'danger' for working households, Suze Orman says
item.description: A new survey shows even a $500 unexpected expense may throw households off track when it comes to big life goals like saving for retirement.

item.title: How a physician with a 1 a.m. bedtime optimizes his health: I try to 'tick all the longevity boxes that I can'
item.description: Dr. Ronald Primas, a longevity physician, offers concierge services like developing personalized health plans for clients. Here are his own wellness practices.

item.title: Warren Buffett Watch: It's Buffett, not Abel, who appears to be calling the shots on stocks
item.description: New Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel appears to be letting Warren Buffett and portfolio manager Ted Weschler make all the decisions on the company's equities.

item.title: Airbnb's new fee change frustrates hosts—what to know before renting out your home
item.description: A new Airbnb fee change is one of many costs and considerations that can affect whether running a short-term rental makes money.

item.title: Why some of America's biggest brands are losing ground in China
item.description: Nike, Starbucks and GM have lost ground in China as domestic rivals, geopolitics and changing consumer preferences reshape the market.

item.title: These stocks are most overbought even as the S&P 500 posts a losing week
item.description: Several stocks remain technically overbought even as the S&P 500 pulled back on the week amid rising Treasury yields and inflation concerns.

item.title: For young Americans, the workplace is the new phoneless frontier. 'It allows us to hyper focus on the task at hand,' says employer
item.description: Schools and increasingly teen employers are drawing a hard line against phone use. The benefits for teens can be profound.

item.title: Six investors reveal the biggest market risks — and one strategy they agree on
item.description: Investors see different risks threatening markets, but broadly agree that traders should diversify beyond recent winners.

item.title: The biggest U.S. stocks have done great for you. Experts say not to get greedy
item.description: Low-cost S&P 500 index funds are the foundation of many portfolios to grow wealth, but investors should add assets to diversify and lower volatility.

item.title: Ukrainian drones kill several, hit warehouse of Russian online retailer Ozon
item.description: The strike is the first on Ozon, Russia's second-largest online retailer, which Ukraine sees as part of a wider campaign against economic infrastructure.

item.title: Rising yields rattled the market, but we’re sticking with our favorite AI and retail stocks
item.description: Stocks took their cue from the bond market this week.

item.title: Accordia Bank is offering a 5.00% APY booster on high-yield savings account for its rebrand — how to get it
item.description: Utah residents can snag a 5.00% APY boost as Accordia Bank celebrates its rebrand, while everyone else can still earn a competitive rate.

item.title: Ray Dalio says Bessent move is sign that a debt crisis is getting closer; recommends gold and bitcoin
item.description: Billionaire investor Ray Dalio said the the debt buyback announcement this week fits into a larger pattern that could signal a forthcoming debt crisis.

item.title: Pentagon fires U.S. military newspaper leadership for 'insubordination'
item.description: The editor-in-chief of the Stars and Stripes U.S. military newspaper said on Friday that he was being fired for insubordination.

item.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to continue White House ballroom construction for now
item.description: President Donald Trump had the White House's East Wing demolished in 2025 to make way for his controversial planned ballroom.

item.title: Anthropic IPO filing will show AI backlash as a risk factor, sources say
item.description: Anthropic is poised to debut on the stock market at a time when the public is increasingly upset about data centers and is fearful about AI taking jobs.

item.title: Longer-dated Treasury yields rise as Bessent's bond buyback rally fizzles out
item.description: Concerns over the Treasury Department's debt repurchase program continue to weigh on markets.

item.title: Bessent's bond gambit aimed at calming markets is instead stirring inflation worries
item.description: The so-called breakeven rate hit its highest levels in more than two months.

item.title: Ken Griffin says Citadel unwound more than 80% of risk tied to Situational Awareness portfolio
item.description: Citadel has unwound more than 80% of the portfolio risk it acquired from Situational Awareness through over $4 billion in block trades, said Ken Griffin.

item.title: Tesla recalls 3 million vehicles in China over doorhandle safety, driver monitoring
item.description: Tesla will voluntarily recall about 3 million of its vehicles in China to address doorhandle safety concerns and deficient driver monitoring systems.
